summary: Validated public API flows and mobile role experiences at 390x844. Core feed, support, publish, live controls, admin queue, and modal interaction work; moderation resolve is not persisted.

critical.issue: No moderation resolve endpoint exists; the admin Resolve report button only closes the modal and leaves the report status open in MongoDB.

integration_issues.issue: Resolve control provides no API request or persistence; reopening admin queue would show the report as open.
UI shows success immediately without checking fetch response status or displaying network/API errors.

action_items: Add an authenticated moderation resolve API operation that updates report status and audit data, then wire admin-resolve-report-button to it and refresh queue metrics.
Handle publish/live/support non-2xx responses with an in-screen error state instead of unconditional confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: No auth or role enforcement is implemented on public post, support, live, report, or admin endpoints; role selection is client-side only.
Payment collection and live broadcast transport are explicitly MOCKED as documented.
All requested API responses exclude MongoDB _id correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flows pass; moderation persistence not implemented)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ post, support, live session, and moderation report records through public APIs; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview https://reporter-hub-11.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Resolve modal button is reachable after scroll and closes locally, but backend queue remains open because no resolve API exists.
rca_of_issue: AdminHome sets selected to null in the Resolve report onPress handler (index.tsx) and never calls fetch. Backend server.py implements POST /api/reports only and has no status update route, so the moderation action cannot persist.
